cowl.definition: a covering for the head and neck, often part of a garment or protective equipment

cowl.definition: to cover with a hood or similar head covering

cloister.definition: a covered walkway or enclosed courtyard in a monastery or church

Tourists visited the cloister behind the cathedral.

cloister.definition: to keep someone in a religious community and limit their contact with the outside world

confluence.definition: the coming together of events or forces

creak.definition: to make a low squeaking sound, especially when moving or when under strain
